parsed.rationale: Both participating records — `RadioPlayerTests.pauseStopsPlayback` (line 160) and `RadioPlayerTests.pauseResetsStream` (line 181) — carry `is_test: true` in their context flags. Collapsing or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated assertions. The restraint rule for test fixtures dominates the near-duplicate signal here.
